snippet.text:
structure Selection (B : Table L) where
  room : Chamber B timeAxis
  unselected : Spread room
  space : unselected.Resolution
  ensemble : space.X → Table L
  atPoint : space.X
  leaps : Chamber (ensemble atPoint) timeAxis
  slabs : Spread leaps

proof_context.conclusion: The selection carries the phase space `space`, the phase tables `ensemble` and the selected point `atPoint`.

snippet.text:
structure Selection.Certificate {P : DiffPlan S} (R : S.Rotation) (J : S.Stress) (C : Selection S) : Prop where
  lengths : Spread.Laws C.unselected P
  still : ∀ x : C.room.D, ∀ i, C.room.flow.U i x = x
  decomposition : C.space.Out
  chosen (i) : C.space.receives (C.ensemble i) i
  states (i) : (C.ensemble i).Hierarchy
  sym i : R.Oriented (C.ensemble i)
  retains i d : (C.ensemble i).null d=S.null d
  coordinates i : P.Inclusions (C.ensemble i)
  calculus i : P.Derivatives (C.ensemble i)
  flux i : Table.StressLaws (C.ensemble i) J P.deriv R.lie
  goes : Spread.Laws C.slabs P
  heat : C.leaps.UniqueHeat

proof_context.conclusion: The certificate gives the decomposition, the phase tables on the same quotients, and `heat : C.leaps.UniqueHeat`, the unique ground state of the selected phase.

snippet.text:
structure Reconstruction (L : EveryPhase.Almanac F) : Prop where
  unselected : F.B.From S
  selected : F.A.From (F.α.ensemble F.α.atPoint)
  chosen : WightmanAxioms F.action F.A.world
  characters (i : F.α.space.X) : WightmanAxioms (L.actors i) (L.contours i).world
  average (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Union) (g : Joint n) :
    (∫ i, (L.contours i).world.W n v g ∂F.α.space.μ) = F.B.world.W n v g

proof_context.conclusion: `Reconstruction` gives Wightman axioms (with a unique vacuum) for the selected phase and for every character, and the average over `F.α.space.μ`.

theorem publicReconstruction (L : EveryPhase.Almanac F) (h : EveryPhase.Completed F L) :
    (hierarchy F Q).Reconstructed := by

proof_context.conclusion: `publicReconstruction` turns `EveryPhase.Completed F L` into `Reconstructed` for the hierarchy.
